meta.note: Designed from scratch for the Purser macOS app (SwiftUI). Platform and screens taken from docs/specs/2026-10-09-purser-v1-design.md in LubosBury/Purser at 2ec1cf9; the repo has no code or styles yet.

color.note: One theme: dark, starting from true black. Glass tokens are translucent white over black; text tokens are checked at 4.5:1 or more on canvas, surface-1..3 and on glass-fill up to its hover state.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Window ground and the stage behind all glass. Never put glass on anything lighter than surface-3.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Sidebar and toolbar ground when no blur is available (reduced transparency).

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Opaque fallback for cards and tables; ground of the diff table.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Opaque fallback for sheets, popovers and menus; the lightest ground any text may sit on.

tokens.name: glass-fill
tokens.usage: Resting fill of every glass panel, card, field and secondary button. Text on it: text-primary, text-secondary, text-tertiary.

tokens.name: glass-fill-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of glass controls and table rows. Highest fill any text may sit on.

tokens.name: glass-fill-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed fill of glass controls; carries only text-primary and icons.

tokens.name: glass-border
tokens.usage: Hairline around glass panels (decorative; the edge of a panel is also carried by its fill).

tokens.name: glass-highlight
tokens.usage: Top inner edge light of a glass panel, used inside the glass shadow tokens.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dim layer behind a sheet or modal confirmation.

tokens.name: separator
tokens.usage: Divider lines between table rows and toolbar groups (decorative).

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Outline of text fields, checkboxes and segmented controls; 4:1 on surface-2 and on glass-fill.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Body text, values and headings on canvas, surface-1..3 and glass.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Labels, column headers and supporting copy on canvas, surface-1..3 and glass.

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Captions, timestamps, hints and placeholder text; 4.5:1 or more up to glass-fill-hover.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled control labels only. Exempt from contrast rules because the control is inactive; never use for information.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Focus ring, selected-tab marker, progress fill and icons. 3:1 or more on canvas and glass; not for body text.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Links and text-only buttons on canvas, surfaces and glass (6:1 on glass-fill).

tokens.name: accent-fill
tokens.usage: Fill of the primary button (Apply, Build plan). Text on it: on-accent.

tokens.name: accent-fill-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of the primary button. Darker, so on-accent keeps 5.5:1.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent-fill, accent-fill-hover and every ws-* fill.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Selected row and selected sidebar item background. Text on it: text-primary.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Info badge text and icon on info-tint.

tokens.name: info-tint
tokens.usage: Info badge background.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Verified, Done, Effective: text and icon on success-tint, glass and canvas. Always paired with a word or check icon.

tokens.name: success-tint
tokens.usage: Success badge background.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: WARN findings, Paused, Stale: text and icon on warning-tint, glass and canvas. Always paired with a word or triangle icon.

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Warning badge background.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: BLOCK findings, errors and destructive text on danger-tint, glass and canvas. Always paired with a word or octagon icon.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Danger badge background and the highlight on rows that block a plan.

tokens.name: danger-fill
tokens.usage: Production workspace banner and the destructive button fill. Text on it: on-accent.

tokens.name: ws-blue
tokens.usage: Workspace banner color option. Text on it: on-accent (5.8:1).

tokens.name: ws-teal
tokens.usage: Workspace banner color option. Text on it: on-accent (5.2:1).

tokens.name: ws-green
tokens.usage: Workspace banner color option. Text on it: on-accent (5.4:1).

tokens.name: ws-amber
tokens.usage: Workspace banner color option. Text on it: on-accent (6.2:1).

tokens.name: ws-pink
tokens.usage: Workspace banner color option. Text on it: on-accent (6.3:1).

tokens.name: ws-graphite
tokens.usage: Workspace banner color option and the default for a new workspace. Text on it: on-accent (9.1:1).

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Helvetica Neue", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: title-large
styles.usage: Screen title in the content area (Catalog, Plan).

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Column headers, button labels, banner text.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default text, table cells, form fields.

styles.name: callout
styles.usage: Supporting copy under a field or panel title.

styles.name: subheadline
styles.usage: Badges, segmented-control labels, sidebar section labels.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Prices, deltas and percentages in the diff table; aligned right in a monospaced column.

styles.name: identifier
styles.usage: Key ID, issuer ID, app ID, plan hash, audit fingerprint.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label; badge vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; button horizontal padding in small size.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding, gap inside a toolbar.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding, gap between panels.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Sheet padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections of a screen.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Content-area margin on wide windows.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Empty-state spacing.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, segmented control, checkbox (4px inside a 14px box).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Table container, popovers, menu.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Glass panels and cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Sheets and the confirmation dialog.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Badges and the progress bar.

shadow.note: Glass edge = a soft drop shadow plus a 1px inner top highlight. Values are for dark grounds only.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Glass panels and cards.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Sheets, popovers and menus floating above the content.

tokens.name: shadow-control
tokens.usage: Buttons and segmented control thumb.

tokens.name: shadow-focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: a black gap, then accent. 5.8:1 on canvas, 4.6:1 on surface-3.

blur.note: backdrop-filter radii for glass. Pair with saturate(1.6) in bundle.css.

tokens.name: blur-sm
tokens.usage: Table header and toolbar.

tokens.name: blur-md
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, sidebar.

tokens.name: blur-lg
tokens.usage: Sheets and popovers.
